name: Dancenter Promenade Near Cihampelas Walk
detail: The location is very strategic, close to various attractions, with complete facilities including comfortable parking and hot water always available. The rooms are spacious and clean, and the friendly and responsive staff make the stay even more enjoyable. The prices offered are very reasonable given the quality received.

name: Townhouse Oak Casa D'Ladera Bandung
detail: The room is spacious and comfortable. Staying here for 5 nights was quite enjoyable because it is quiet, close to UPI campus, near Lembang, and there are many places to eat. There is a gym available. They provided 2 towels, 2 small bottles of mineral water, and 1 bottle of body wash, and the water heater works well. The AC is very cold. The cable TV works well. There is a small fridge, but unfortunately, the fridge in my room was broken. Perhaps more attention should be given to the bed linens and towels as their colors have become dull and dirty. The cleanliness of the bathroom is lacking because there were still some hair leftovers. The staff is friendly. There is ample parking. I recommend staying here.

name: Collection O Riau Near Trans Studio Bandung Formerly Hotel Montameri
detail: This hotel has a cheap rate and is best used for guests who are in transit or just need a room to sleep in without any other requirements. The room is quite spacious, without drinking water in the room or towels. The room is not dirty but also not as clean as a **** hotel. According to the room price, don't expect too much. There is car parking available, and the hotel is located on the side of the road, making it easy to find. Overall, it’s suitable for a brief sleep. Only in the morning, the front office staff are not on standby, so one has to wait. Hopefully, even with the low price, the hotel can improve its service and room facilities.

name: Tokyo Cubo
detail: The place is very comfortable for solo travelers. The beds are clean, there are plenty of clean toilets, the receptionists are friendly, and they provide security for motorcycles.

name: Savoy Homann
detail: Staying at the Savoy was the best experience I had in Bandung, with a strategic location, overall cleanliness of the hotel, and spacious and comfortable rooms. The staff were friendly from the moment I arrived, during the check-in process, at the restaurant during breakfast, and also during check-out. It might be helpful to provide information regarding the hotel facilities during the check-in process, such as the locations of the gym, swimming pool, and breakfast area, which would be more informative for guests. Also, there is a welcome drink voucher for coffee or tea that can be redeemed at the restaurant. The parking is spacious and free for guests staying at the hotel. In conclusion, it was a satisfying experience, and I will most likely return to stay here again.

name: Hilton Bandung
detail: Hotel dengan kamar terluas yg prnah sy dan kluarga kunjungi, kasurnya ada 2 queenbed, kamar mandi luas, terpisah antara kloset dan shower room, aminities lengkap, sabun shampo dan lotion wangi nya enakkk, resto nya makanannya enakkk, menu sarapannya yang sangat lengkap dan beragam, mulai dr nasi goreng smpe sushi pun ada, roti2annya enak, minumannya lengkap,, ada cokelat, kopi, jus, sampe jamu pun ada. Lokasinya persis samping paskal 23, jadi kalo mau k mall tinggal jalan kaki aja..kids corner dan kolamnya juga bagus, tp sayang air kolam nya dingin..tp ga mengurangi penilaian kami ttg hotel hilton, pelayanannya bagus, sangat helpful dan ramah2, sangat rekomen,

name: Hotel Neo Kota Baru Parahyangan
detail: Getting to this hotel is very easy from Jakarta or Bandung. Just exit at the Padalarang toll gate and continue towards Kota Baru Parahyangan, its location is right next to the Pertamina gas station and KFC. The parking facilities are spacious, as it is integrated with other commercial areas there. The lobby is very functional, not too big but fine. Security is good with security personnel on standby to open the door. Access to the rooms via the lift requires the room card. The room is quite comfortable, and the mattress is soft. Just a note that the air conditioner makes a little noise at high fan settings. Breakfast can be delivered to the room and it tastes quite good. The variety is also quite good. Thank you Neo KBP, we will return another time.

name: Aryaduta Bandung
detail: So at first, the room smelled musty and I discussed it with the receptionist. Long story short, they were very helpful and quickly moved our room from the 9th floor to the 8th. The staff was friendly and top-notch when it comes to handling complaints.. I really liked it! The breakfast was also delicious, especially the Indonesian food.. oh, I even had seconds, the liwet rice ⭐️5, the beef tripe stew ⭐️5, the sambel dadak ⭐️5. The chili squid was also tasty ⭐️5. The other food was fine too. I will definitely stay here again..

name: Kedaton Hotel
detail: I am happy with the old hotel with spacious rooms (feels more comfortable), strategically located especially for those who want to walk to Braga Street (less than a 5-minute walk), spacious and comfortable parking area, gym and pool facilities, all at an economical price.

name: Nindya Biodistrict Hotel
detail: The accommodation is very comfortable, and for that price, you can say it’s worth it. The room is clean and cozy, and the design of the room is also aesthetic, very cute. Plus, the facilities are quite complete; there’s AC, fluffy towels, and a thick, fragrant bedding. The bathroom is also clean, has hot water, and there’s a hairdryer too. Highly recommended for solo travelers who plan to stay in an affordable accommodation but still feel comfortable and satisfied with that price. Additionally, the staff is very nice.
